notes: BattleBot 3.3: a fresh look, a menu you can click, and it goes back to the menu after a run instead of closing

BattleBot Quick attack: click record quick, play one battle like normal, then click the BattleBot window when you are home. From then on it plays that battle for you, ending at a slightly random time each run
Screen Director: an app's screen can't get switched by accident anymore, and it tells you when you move one
